create_algorithm: create a JWT algorithm object from an algorithm name like RS256 or ES256
parse_jwt_public_key_json: parse a JWK formatted JSON payload to extract and return a PEM public key
parse_jwt_public_key_pem: parse and validate a PEM formatted public key string for JWT algorithm compatibility
get_jwt_public_keys: fetch and compile JWT public keys from a URL and additional PEM keys into a list
validate_jwt: validate a JWT token against public keys checking sub claim, permissions, and expiration
